messages:
elaine (prod): thinking out loud — can we add a tiny persistent save/view FAB on the route inspector so folks can pin a per-route filter set without opening the full saved queries modal?

jay (frontend): agree, small FAB that anchors to the right edge? maybe 'Save view' with a 3-state dropdown: Save, Save & Share, Unpin.

priya (backend): curious how we'd model it server-side — is a FAB pin just a savedQuery with scope=route and sticky=true? we should avoid creating lots of ephemeral objects.

morgan (analytics): +1 for minimal objects. If we create a 'pinned_view' flag on saved_views, we can treat it as a lightweight pointer in the route config. Also need telemetry to know when pinned views are used vs ephemeral local filters.

rachel (pm): use cases: on-call wants immediate per-route filters, product leads want per-model cost views defaulted. So UX needs to surface owner and scope (team/route/global).

sam (devex): can we keep the client-side local filters (no API call) if user just toggles temporarily, and only call /saved-views when they click the FAB -> Save? avoids explosion of objects.

elaine (prod): exactly — UX: quick pin (1 click) = local but persisted for this org+route, show small pill; full 'Save & Share' opens the modal to add description, teams, permissions.

jay (frontend): implementation detail: pill UI should be compact, show owner initials and a tiny chevron. On hover show quick actions: rename, share, unpin.

priya (backend): API sketch: POST /api/saved-views {"name":"Pinned - /routes/ingest","scope":"route","route_id":"r_123","filters":{...},"pinned":true,"visibility":"team"} returns id and shortcut_token.

morgan (analytics): clarify telemetry: every time a route loads with a pinned view applied, emit event: route_view_applied {view_id, route_id, user_tier, tokens_est}. This lets us measure adoption and cost impact.

rachel (pm): decision point: default pin scope should be 'route' but team leads can pin at 'team' or 'org' level. Need guardrails for 'org' pins — require approval?

sam (devex): also need quotas: saved_views count per org, pinned_views dont bypass quota. If we allow many pins per route it could explode. Propose limit 5 pinned views per route by default.

priya (backend): agreed. We'll enforce in DB and return 429 with body {"code":"pin_limit_exceeded","limit":5}.

jay (frontend): UI for limit: on attempt to pin beyond limit show a small error toast with link to manage pinned views. Maybe show existing pins as compact row so users can replace.

elaine (prod): A/B test idea: expose FAB to 10% of routes for 2 weeks; measure time-to-pin, frequency of reuse, and error rate on save. If positive, roll to 100%.

morgan (analytics): will add a dashboard: pinned_views adoption, avg tokens per pinned session, top pinned filters. I can reuse existing per-route telemetry pipeline.

rachel (pm): permissions: sharing defaults to 'private' for personal pins, 'team' for pinned by team admins. Need 'transfer ownership' flow.

sam (devex): operational note: migrating older saved_queries to new pinned model — run a migration that marks recent per-route saved_queries with pinned=true if used > N times in last 30d. We'll discuss threshold.

priya (backend): db schema notes: saved_views table gets columns: pinned boolean, route_id nullable, owner_user_id, visibility enum, last_applied_at timestamp. Index route_id + pinned for fast lookup on route load.

jay (frontend): client load path: GET /api/routes/:id?pinned_view=true returns pinned view merged with default filters. Need to handle merge conflicts (user override vs pinned). I suggest pinned merges first, then local overrides win.

elaine (prod): UX copy: tooltip for FAB: "Pin this view to this route — quick access for this team". Small confirmation on first pin.

morgan (analytics): also capture rollouts UX metric: pinned_view_rollback if user disables a pin during canary.

savebot: deployed 1928501302: feature-flag:console_pinned_views -> enabled for 10% orgs

rachel (pm): next steps: draft API spec + frontend mock by EOD Wed. Priya + Jay to own proto. Morgan to prepare telemetry events. Sam to add quota enforcement design. Elaine will coordinate copy and microcopy.

priya (backend): ack, will draft API spec. One more Q: should pins be versioned with model? e.g., if a route swaps model variant, do we re-evaluate pinned filters?

elaine (prod): keep pins model-agnostic for now, but include optional model_version field so teams can pin per-model if desired. We can iterate.

jay (frontend): I'll add a small note in mock: "applies to model: any / pinned to model v2" selector.

morgan (analytics): I'll add a tag on events: pinned_view.model_affinity = optional string.

rachel (pm): great. if no objections I'll put this in the 2-week sprint. :shipit: 

sam (devex): small follow-up: wire the saved_views endpoint to the console's bookmark list so pin appears in 'My saved views' not just per-route.

elaine (prod): perfect. thanks all.

jay (frontend): thanks — will push initial mock tomorrow. :rocket:
